characters.name: Alfred
characters.clueZh: 他恰好在 Ivan 北边一行。
characters.clueEn: He was exactly one row north of Ivan.

characters.name: Barry
characters.clueZh: 他在小卖部，与一名游客独处。
characters.clueEn: He was in Concessions alone with a Visitor.

characters.name: Carolyn
characters.clueZh: 她恰好在 Deborah 北边一行。
characters.clueEn: She was exactly one row north of Deborah.

characters.name: Deborah
characters.clueEn: She was in the Main Area.

characters.name: Eloise
characters.clueEn: She was beside a table. She was not sitting.

characters.name: Gordon
characters.clueEn: He was sitting in a chair. He was alone.

characters.name: Jim
characters.clueEn: He was not in water, but he was beside water.

characters.name: Langston
characters.clueZh: 他在水里，不在动物旁边。
characters.clueEn: He was in water. He was not beside an animal.

characters.name: Vlad
characters.clueEn: The Victim. He was alone with the murderer.

generalClues.text: A–H 为游客，I–O 与 V 为饲养员；仅饲养员能进栖息地。
6 个栖息地，每个都至少有一名饲养员。
